head: Galaxy S27 Ultra design leak: raised camera plateau with three cameras
dek: Leaker Ice Universe posted a drawing he calls the real design of the Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra: a raised camera area with three rear cameras. Samsung hasn't confirmed it.
details: Dummy units seen days earlier showed a fourth camera, which Ice Universe says doesn't exist; the Galaxy S26 Ultra has four. Android Authority lists reported cameras: a 200 MP main camera on both, a 3x telephoto on the Pro and possibly a 50 MP 5x telephoto on the Ultra. The regular S27 and S27+ are expected to keep their current look.
means: If you're waiting for the next Ultra, it may look new but have one camera fewer than the S26 Ultra.
todo: Nothing to do yet; prices and official pictures are still unknown.
thumb_words: GALAXY S27 ULTRA: NEW CAMERA LOOK?
